description: Flagged for Review: irregularities and unverified items. These are published (not hidden) and do not block deployment. Every flag carries the relevant source link where one exists.

flags.item: Depth-chart data has no single official machine-readable feed
flags.detail: Depth charts are published per team and via gamebooks; third-party aggregators (e.g. OurLads, Sportskeeda, StickToTheModel) are not official and are used only as leads. Starter/backup strings must be confirmed against official team/league sources before use.

flags.item: Line / odds values are model-originated, not sourced market data
flags.detail: All lines are model-implied probabilities (M5). No bookmaker odds are scraped or presented as source data. Model outputs are labelled model-originated.

flags.item: Injury tracking is weekly-only and lacks a historical archive
flags.detail: Only the official weekly injury report is verified. A historical injury/roster archive and a retention policy are still required for back-testing.

flags.item: Correlation values are not yet computed
flags.detail: The correlation method is defined (M2) but empirical correlation values are blank until computed from official play-level data.

flags.item: No strategy has passed validation yet
flags.detail: Strategies are frameworks. No performance results are reported until each passes the validation gates; performance cells are intentionally blank.

flags.item: Player-prop grading rules are partially documented
flags.detail: The 'player must play' action rule is verified from regulator sources. Full per-market grading, partial-participation and overtime treatment still to be documented.
Betting rules vary by jurisdiction. The model uses official regulator definitions but has not locked a single operating jurisdiction.

flags.item: Responsible-gaming disclosure present; jurisdiction limits not set
flags.detail: A responsible-gaming and risk disclosure is included on every page. Jurisdiction-specific limits and access controls are not configured.
Standings and team records verified live on 2026-11-13 (Week 10) will age as the season progresses and must be refreshed by the ingestion layer.

flags.item: Roster/IR rule specifics to be re-confirmed against the rulebook
flags.detail: IR return eligibility and practice-squad facts are sourced from official NFL.com news (S7). Current 2026 roster-limit specifics should be re-confirmed against the official 2026 rulebook (S3).
